---
title: "Isla Verde Transfer Tax Explained for Condo Buyers"
description: "How the Isla Verde transfer tax is calculated on a condo purchase, when it is paid and which exemptions apply to first-time buyers in 2026."
pubDate: 2026-02-02
author: Isla Verde Editorial
---

**Quick answer:** the transfer tax is 1.5% of the declared price and is paid at registration.

<Callout type="note">
The notary collects the tax on the day of signing.

## When it is paid

At registration, 21 days after the deposit.
